clause: Ink manager (spot->process / aliasing / Lab / trap type) [STU-COL-027]

scope.summary: Ink manager MUST provide per-ink spot-to-process conversion, all-spots-to-process, ink aliasing (map one ink to another), use-standard-Lab-values-for-spots, and per-ink trap type (normal / transparent / opaque / opaque-ignore) with neutral density and trapping sequence (InDesign Ink Manager). It operates on native StudioSwatch(spot) inks ([STU-COL-020]). Operator ink-manager + model command.
acceptance_criteria: spot->process (per-ink + all), aliasing, standard-Lab-for-spots, per-ink trap type + neutral density + sequence
expected_tests: live: per-ink + all-spots spot-to-process conversion; ink aliasing; use-standard-Lab-for-spots
test: per-ink trap type {normal,transparent,opaque,opaque_ignore} + neutral density + sequence on StudioSwatch(spot)

risk_if_missed: No ink management; separation control + trapping foundation unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
